READABILITY.evidence: The two added lines read clearly and follow the existing validation style in Prefetch.__init__: `if queryset is not None and queryset.query.is_sliced: raise ValueError("Prefetch querysets cannot use slices.")`

MAINTAINABILITY.evidence: The change is small and clean, but it is in the wrong layer. It forbids the feature in Prefetch.__init__ when the fix belonged in a shared helper in related_descriptors.py. It also makes slicing harder to support later, since valid uses now error early.

ROBUSTNESS.evidence: The guard rejects a valid input that the issue asks to support. Prefetch(..., queryset=Post.objects.all()[:3]) now raises ValueError at construction instead of working. All 4 F2P tests fail.

C6-05-CASE1.evidence: No per-parent slicing is implemented. There is no Window/RowNumber and no clear_limits; the agent only added `raise ValueError("Prefetch querysets cannot use slices.")`. Open-ended and bounded slices both fail.
